mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tour.organizer_managers ( users_id, organizers_id, position ) VALUES ( (SELECT id FROM auth.users u WHERE u.email = #{email}), #{organizersId}, CAST(#{position} AS manager_position_type) ) ON CONFLICT (users_id, organizers_id) DO UPDATE SET position = EXCLUDED.position

INSERT INTO public.hotel_managers ( users_id, hotels_id, position ) VALUES ( (SELECT id FROM auth.users u WHERE u.email = #{email}), #{hotelsId}, CAST(#{position} AS manager_position_type) ) ON CONFLICT (users_id, hotels_id) DO UPDATE SET position = EXCLUDED.position
mapper.select: SELECT u.* FROM tour.organizer_managers om JOIN auth.users u ON om.users_id = u.id WHERE om.organizers_id = #{id} AND om.position = CAST('ADMIN' AS manager_position_type)
